title: Accounting and Tax Services for Foreign Investors in Canadian Real Estate

rows.before: The combined Ontario rate of about 12.2% on the first $500,000 of active business income is the figure most owners have in mind when they incorporate, and more than one condition stands between a non-resident-owned property company and it.
rows.after: The combined Ontario rate of about 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) on the first $500,000 of active business income is the figure most owners have in mind when they incorporate, and more than one condition stands between a non-resident-owned property company and it.
rows.note: First R1 change on page; parenthetical added.

rows.before: A non-resident investor registered an Ontario corporation to buy a Thornbury property, having been told abroad that a Canadian company would pay around 12.2% on its first $500,000.
rows.after: A non-resident investor registered an Ontario corporation to buy a Thornbury property, having been told abroad that a Canadian company would pay around 11.2% on its first $500,000.
